cards.example_en: These comfortable trainers are what I wear for long walks.
cards.example_zh: 我走远路时就穿这双舒适的运动鞋。

cards.example_en: Plastic rulers are common in nearly every pencil case.
cards.example_zh: 几乎每个铅笔盒里都有塑料尺，这很常见。

cards.example_en: We communicate with our friends online.
cards.example_zh: 我们在线上与朋友沟通。

cards.example_en: Our community opened a small library in the old post office.
cards.example_zh: 我们社区在旧邮局里开了一间小图书馆。

cards.example_en: Dad's company donated footballs to every class in our grade.
cards.example_zh: 爸爸的公司给我们年级每个班捐赠了足球。

cards.example_en: Compare these two maps before choosing a route.
cards.example_zh: 选路线之前先比较这两张地图。

cards.example_en: Five teams will compete for the prize.
cards.example_zh: 五支球队将争夺奖品。

cards.example_en: Please complete this form before you leave the office.
cards.example_zh: 离开办公室前，请把这份表格填写完成。

cards.example_en: The library computer crashed while I was printing my essay.
cards.example_zh: 我正在打印作文时，图书馆的电脑死机了。

cards.example_en: My violin teacher saved me a seat at her evening concert.
cards.example_zh: 小提琴老师在她的晚场音乐会上给我留了座位。

cards.example_en: The car is in good condition.
cards.example_zh: 这辆车的车况还不错。

cards.example_en: Winning the debate gave Nora new confidence in speaking aloud.
cards.example_zh: 赢下辩论后，诺拉当众说话有了新的信心。

cards.example_en: Please accept my congratulation on your prize.
cards.example_zh: 请接受我对你获奖的祝贺。

cards.example_en: Connect the printer to the computer with this cable.
cards.example_zh: 用这根线把打印机连到电脑上。

cards.example_en: Consider the weather before you leave for the picnic.
cards.example_zh: 出发去野餐前，先考虑一下天气。

cards.example_en: Continue the story from the page where we stopped.
cards.example_zh: 从我们上次停下的那一页继续读这个故事。

cards.example_en: She lost control of the kite when a sudden gust hit the field.
cards.example_zh: 突然一阵风刮过场地，她控制不住风筝了。

cards.example_en: Is Tuesday convenient for you?
cards.example_zh: 星期二对您来说方便吗？

cards.example_en: Their conversation about the match lasted the whole bus ride home.
cards.example_zh: 他们关于那场比赛的对话持续了整个回家的车程。

cards.example_en: Dad will cook noodles for the whole family tonight.
cards.example_zh: 爸爸今晚会给全家人煮面条。

cards.example_en: She shared a cookie with her brother.
cards.example_zh: 她分给弟弟一块饼干。

cards.example_en: The cool shade under the oak saved us from the heat.
cards.example_zh: 橡树下凉爽的树荫让我们躲开了酷热。

cards.example_en: The two countries agreed to cooperate.
cards.example_zh: 两国同意合作。

cards.example_en: The office made an extra copy of my form for the school file.
cards.example_zh: 办公室多做了一份我的表格副本，放进学校档案。

cards.example_en: Farmers grow corn in this field.
cards.example_zh: 农民在这块地里种玉米。

cards.example_en: We waited at the corner until the rain slowed to a drizzle.
cards.example_zh: 我们在拐角等到雨势变成了毛毛雨。

cards.example_en: Check that the correct name is printed on your exam card.
cards.example_zh: 核对准考证上印的姓名是否正确。

cards.example_en: The cost of new football boots was more than I had saved.
cards.example_zh: 新足球鞋的花费比我攒下的钱还多。

cards.example_en: This T-shirt is made of cotton.
cards.example_zh: 这件T恤是棉的。

cards.example_en: Cover your mouth if you cough in the classroom.
cards.example_zh: 如果在教室里咳嗽，请捂住嘴巴。

cards.example_en: Could you open the window, please?
cards.example_zh: 你能打开窗户吗？

cards.example_en: Count the chairs before the guests sit down.
cards.example_zh: 客人坐下之前，先数一数椅子。

cards.example_en: Canada is the country my cousin moved to last summer.
cards.example_zh: 加拿大是我表姐去年夏天搬去的国家。

cards.example_en: We cycled through the countryside and stopped to pick blackberries.
cards.example_zh: 我们骑车穿过乡下，还停下来摘了黑莓。

cards.example_en: The couple in front of us shared headphones on the train.
cards.example_zh: 我们前面的那一对在火车上合用一副耳机。

cards.example_en: It took courage to speak in front of the class.
cards.example_zh: 在全班面前发言需要勇气。

cards.example_en: The photography course uses the darkroom behind the art studio.
cards.example_zh: 摄影课程使用美术教室后面的暗房。

cards.example_en: My cousin is coming to stay with us.
cards.example_zh: 我的表弟将入住我们的房源。

cards.example_en: Cover the pot while the soup is still boiling.
cards.example_zh: 汤还在煮的时候，把锅盖上。

cards.example_en: The neighbour's cow pushed her head over the fence towards our apples.
cards.example_zh: 邻居家的奶牛把头伸过篱笆，凑向我们的苹果。

cards.example_en: The fans went crazy when the team scored.
cards.example_zh: 球队进球时球迷都疯了。

cards.example_en: We create a short play for the school festival.
cards.example_zh: 我们为学校的节日创作一个短剧。

cards.example_en: His creative use of cardboard became a model of our town.
cards.example_zh: 他有创意地用纸板做成了我们小镇的模型。

cards.example_en: The two main streets cross near the city library.
cards.example_zh: 两条主要街道在市图书馆附近交叉。

cards.example_en: The bus was very crowded this morning.
cards.example_zh: 今天早上公交车很挤。

cards.example_en: The baby may cry when the bedroom lights go out.
cards.example_zh: 卧室的灯灭了以后，宝宝可能会哭。

cards.example_en: I put cucumber in the salad.
cards.example_zh: 我在沙拉里放了黄瓜。

cards.example_en: I am interested in Chinese culture.
cards.example_zh: 我对中国文化感兴趣。

cards.example_en: This cup has a crack, so the tea leaks onto the saucer.
cards.example_zh: 这个杯子有裂缝，茶水漏到了碟子上。

cards.example_en: The child was curious about the stars.
cards.example_zh: 孩子对星星很好奇。

word.example_en: We have a lot in common.
People often compare the moon to a plate.
word.example_zh: 人们常把月亮比作盘子。

word.example_en: Do not compare your score with his.
word.example_zh: 别拿你的分数和他的比。

word.example_en: She stayed in control of the boat.
Keep your cool if the other team scores.
word.example_zh: 如果对方得分，保持冷静。

word.example_en: I will stay for a couple of days.
Of course you can borrow my ruler.
word.example_zh: 你当然可以借我的尺子。

word.example_en: My brother is crazy about basketball.
